title: Fix all penetration testing findings (SQL injection, XSS, CORS, Auth)

test_cases.name: SQL Injection prevented via parameterized queries
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect src/sql/patient_history.sql for parameterized binding contract
test_cases.expected_result: PatientCode bound via pyodbc ? placeholder; no dynamic string interpolation
test_cases.evidence: High finding SQL injection prevented via strict pyodbc parameter binding (single ? marker)

test_cases.name: XSS prevention via safe DOM text rendering
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect dynamic text insertion methods in src/static/index.html
test_cases.expected_result: Dynamic untrusted content bound through textContent or escaping helpers
test_cases.evidence: XSS prevention verified: UI components use safe DOM text setters / sanitization

test_cases.name: Malicious SQL payload treated as literal string
test_cases.input_setup: Pass SQL injection payload into history parsing utility
test_cases.expected_result: Payload parsed as inert literal string without syntax execution
test_cases.evidence: SQL injection string treated as inert text without evaluation

test_cases.name: CORS origin configuration forbids wildcard in production
test_cases.expected_result: allow_origins specifies explicit domains; no wildcard '*' allowed

test_cases.name: RBAC gates administrative routes against privilege escalation
test_cases.input_setup: Invoke require_admin with AuthenticatedUser possessing only Doctor role
test_cases.evidence: Administrative endpoint strictly blocked non-admin with HTTP 403
